description: This file defines the 'Field' class in the OpenMRS system, representing a customizable or database-backed field in the application. It includes properties such as field type, associated concept, default value, and responses (answers). The class includes typical getters, setters, and methods to manage answers.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a configurable data field with associated properties such as type, concept, default value, and answers within the OpenMRS medical records system.

methods.name: getFieldId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the field.

methods.name: setFieldId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the field.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: setFieldType
methods.description: Sets the type of the field.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with the field.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates a concept with the field.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the database table backing this field.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the database table name associated with this field.

methods.name: getAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the attribute name for the field.

methods.name: setAttributeName
methods.description: Sets the attribute name for the field.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: isSelectMultiple
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if multiple selection is allowed; use getSelectMultiple().

methods.name: getSelectMultiple
methods.description: Returns whether multiple selection is permitted.

methods.name: setSelectMultiple
methods.description: Sets whether multiple selection is permitted.

methods.name: getAnswers
methods.description: Returns the set of answers associated with this field.

methods.name: setAnswers
methods.description: Sets the answers for this field.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds a answer to the field's answer set.

methods.name: removeAnswer
methods.description: Removes an answer from the field's answer set.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the object, overrides OpenMRSObject method.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the object, overrides OpenMRSObject method.
